decisions.reason: The materials management module is a low-cost add-on to the core dental practice software, and after one year its prospects are still uncertain, so keeping this cheap option open has more value than dropping it now, even though the firm already pruned A and B.

The KIM messaging client is tied to the mandatory telematics infrastructure in German healthcare and is being actively updated (KIM 1.5), so its value is largely confirmed and it calls for further commitment rather than abandonment.
